Skill property: enable query planning

Skill property: query expansion mode — "blind", "corpus-aware-1hop", or "corpus-aware-2hop". Corpus-aware modes harvest real corpus vocabulary from the phrases collection (PRF) and ground the expansion on it. Production default is corpus-aware-2hop (set in build-skill-params-from-config); set "blind" per tenant/dataset to opt out — recommended for org-tagged corpora pending per-corpus validation, since auto-filter can interact with the expanded queries.

Skill property: max chunk length for context assembly

Skill property (retrieval-only): max total length for the final context window
Skill property (retrieval-only): max total length for raw chunk return
Skill property: number of chunks to rerank

Skill property: ordered list of auto-filter rule specs. Each rule self-describes its type, target field, and parameters. Supported types: see digdir.rag.auto-filter-rules. Empty / absent preserves the prior org+year-only auto-detection behavior.

Skill property: list of chunk-collection field names to query with the :content strategy. Defaults to ["content_markdown"] when absent. For per-language stemmed corpora use ["content_markdown_en" "content_markdown_nb"].
Skill property: list of chunk-collection field names to query with the :metadata strategy. Defaults to ["metadata"] when absent. For per-language stemmed corpora use ["metadata_en" "metadata_nb"].
Skill property: per-matched-doc chunk fanout K for the :doc-title strategy. Default 3 if not set.
Skill property: enable retrieval

Skill property: comma-separated enrichment collections to search as sibling strategies — any of "hypothetical-questions", "verified-phrases", "fact-assertions". Empty/absent (default) = OFF. Enable ONLY for datasets whose enrichment collections exist (otherwise retrieval searches a missing collection); enable per tenant/dataset.
Skill property: max candidate chunks allowed per source document

Skill property: rank-fusion mode for merging per-strategy results. Accepts :weighted-sum (default; min-max normalized weighted-sum) or :rrf (Reciprocal Rank Fusion, Cormack et al. SIGIR 2009; pool-size invariant).
Skill property: phrase generation prompt template
Skill property: enable query-aware candidate prioritization
Skill property: RRF smoothing constant. Default 60 (matches Cormack et al. and Elasticsearch). Smaller k spreads more between top and bottom ranks. Only consulted when merge-mode is :rrf.
Skill property: per-strategy contribution caps, e.g. {:phrase 2 :content 1}
Skill property: per-strategy merge weights, e.g. {:phrase 1.0 :content 0.5 :metadata 0.5}

Skill property: list of doc-collection field names to query with the :doc-title strategy. Empty / absent disables the strategy. Fields must exist on the docs collection schema. Example: ["linktitle" "frontmatter_title"]
Skill property: number of chunks to retrieve before reranking
Skill property (slice 23): cap-mode N. Intent pass's first N chunks lock into the merged head. Default 3.

Skill property (slice 23): when true AND the planner emits a distinct :user-intent, retrieval runs a second pass with the intent string only and union-merges the two reranked outputs. Off by default; enabled per-tenant.
Skill property (slice 23): union mode. One of :cap (default; slice-22 winner), :interleave (slice-21 alternating zip), or :rrf (Reciprocal Rank Fusion).
Skill property (slice 23): RRF smoothing constant for the user-intent union. Only consulted when mode is :rrf. Default 60.
Skill property: synthesis generation prompt template
Skill property: max context docs to include during synthesis
Skill property: synthesis max tokens override
Skill property: synthesis model override
Skill property: synthesis system prompt template
Skill property: synthesis temperature override
Enable Malli I/O schema validation for skill executions. Off in production; enable per-tenant for debugging.
